bible_quanes.question: What kind of animal from the herd was required for a burnt offering?
bible_quanes.answer: A male without blemish
bible_quanes.explanation: It was offered at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

bible_quanes.question: Where did the offerer put his hand?
bible_quanes.answer: On the head of the burnt offering
bible_quanes.explanation: It would be accepted to make atonement for him.

bible_quanes.question: How is the burnt offering described to the LORD?
bible_quanes.answer: An offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD

bible_quanes.question: From where did the LORD speak to Moses at the start of Leviticus?
bible_quanes.answer: Out of the tabernacle of the congregation
bible_quanes.explanation: The book opens with God calling Moses there.

bible_quanes.question: What did the priests do with the blood of the burnt offering?
bible_quanes.answer: Sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar
bible_quanes.explanation: At the door of the tabernacle.

bible_quanes.question: What was done to the burnt offering animal after it was killed?
bible_quanes.answer: Flay it and cut it into his pieces

bible_quanes.question: Besides the herd, from which flocks could a burnt offering come?
bible_quanes.answer: The sheep or the goats
bible_quanes.explanation: It had to be a male without blemish.

bible_quanes.question: Which birds could be brought as a burnt offering?
bible_quanes.answer: Turtledoves or young pigeons
bible_quanes.explanation: This allowed poorer worshippers to offer.

bible_quanes.question: Which parts of the burnt offering were washed with water?
bible_quanes.answer: His inwards and his legs
bible_quanes.explanation: Then the whole was burned on the altar.

bible_quanes.question: On which side of the altar was a burnt offering from the flock killed?
bible_quanes.answer: Northward

bible_quanes.question: What was the meat offering made of?
bible_quanes.answer: Fine flour
bible_quanes.explanation: With oil and frankincense on it.

bible_quanes.question: What was not to be included in any meat offering burned to the LORD?
bible_quanes.answer: Leaven or honey
bible_quanes.explanation: Neither was to be burned as an offering.

bible_quanes.question: What was every meat offering to be seasoned with?
bible_quanes.answer: Salt
bible_quanes.explanation: The salt of the covenant of God.

bible_quanes.question: Who ate the rest of the meat offering?
bible_quanes.answer: Aaron and his sons

bible_quanes.question: What portion of the meat offering was burned on the altar?
bible_quanes.answer: The memorial: a handful of the flour and oil, with all the frankincense
bible_quanes.explanation: As a sweet savour to the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: What forms could a meat offering baked in an oven take?
bible_quanes.answer: Unleavened cakes mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil
bible_quanes.explanation: There were several ways to prepare it.

bible_quanes.question: What was offered as a meat offering of firstfruits?
bible_quanes.answer: Green ears of corn dried by the fire

bible_quanes.question: As what kind of offering could leaven and honey be brought?
bible_quanes.answer: An offering of firstfruits
bible_quanes.explanation: But they were not to be burned on the altar.

bible_quanes.question: What was a meat offering baked on a griddle made of?
bible_quanes.answer: Fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil
bible_quanes.explanation: It was broken in pieces with oil poured on it.

bible_quanes.question: In what else could a meat offering be cooked?
bible_quanes.answer: The fryingpan
bible_quanes.explanation: Made of fine flour with oil.

bible_quanes.question: What offering is described in Leviticus 3?
bible_quanes.answer: The peace offering

bible_quanes.question: Could a peace offering from the herd be male or female?
bible_quanes.answer: Whether male or female, without blemish
bible_quanes.explanation: Unlike the burnt offering, it could be female.

bible_quanes.question: What were the Israelites never to eat?
bible_quanes.answer: Fat or blood
bible_quanes.explanation: A perpetual statute in all their dwellings.

bible_quanes.question: To whom does all the fat belong?
bible_quanes.answer: The LORD
bible_quanes.explanation: It was burned as a sweet savour.

bible_quanes.question: Where was the peace offering killed?
bible_quanes.answer: At the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
bible_quanes.explanation: After the offerer laid his hand on its head.

bible_quanes.question: Which part of the liver was offered?
bible_quanes.answer: The caul above the liver

bible_quanes.question: Which part of a lamb's peace offering was burned whole?
bible_quanes.answer: The whole rump, take off hard by the backbone

bible_quanes.question: What other animal could be brought as a peace offering besides cattle and sheep?
bible_quanes.answer: A goat
bible_quanes.explanation: It was offered in the same way.

bible_quanes.question: On top of what was the peace offering burned?
bible_quanes.answer: On the burnt sacrifice on the altar
bible_quanes.explanation: As a sweet savour to the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: What is the burned portion of the peace offering called?
bible_quanes.answer: Food of the offering made by fire to the LORD

bible_quanes.question: What kind of sin is the sin offering in Leviticus 4 for?
bible_quanes.answer: Sin through ignorance
bible_quanes.explanation: Against any of the LORD's commandments.

bible_quanes.question: What did an anointed priest bring if he sinned?
bible_quanes.answer: A young bullock without blemish

bible_quanes.question: What did a ruler bring for an unintentional sin?
bible_quanes.answer: A male kid of the goats without blemish

bible_quanes.question: What did one of the common people bring?
bible_quanes.answer: A female kid of the goats without blemish
bible_quanes.explanation: For the sin he had committed.

bible_quanes.question: How many times did the priest sprinkle blood before the vail?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven times

bible_quanes.question: On which altar's horns did the priest put some of the bull's blood?
bible_quanes.answer: The altar of sweet incense
bible_quanes.explanation: The rest was poured at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

bible_quanes.question: Where was the rest of the priest's sin-offering bull burned?
bible_quanes.answer: Without the camp, unto a clean place where the ashes are poured out
bible_quanes.explanation: Where the ashes were poured out.

bible_quanes.question: What did the whole congregation bring for unintentional sin?
bible_quanes.answer: A young bullock
bible_quanes.explanation: The elders laid their hands on its head.

bible_quanes.question: If a common person brought a lamb for a sin offering, what was required?
bible_quanes.answer: A female without blemish

bible_quanes.question: What was the result when the priest made atonement?
bible_quanes.answer: It shall be forgiven him

bible_quanes.question: What must a guilty person do before bringing the offering?
bible_quanes.answer: Confess that he has sinned

bible_quanes.question: What could someone bring if they could not afford a lamb?
bible_quanes.answer: Two turtledoves or two young pigeons
bible_quanes.explanation: One for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering.

bible_quanes.question: What could the very poor bring instead?
bible_quanes.answer: A tenth of an ephah of fine flour

bible_quanes.question: What was brought for a trespass in the holy things of the LORD?
bible_quanes.answer: A ram without blemish

bible_quanes.question: What sin is described in Leviticus 5:1?
bible_quanes.answer: To hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, and do not utter it

bible_quanes.question: What kind of uncleanness is mentioned in Leviticus 5:2?
bible_quanes.answer: To touch the carcase of an unclean beast

bible_quanes.question: What was not added to the poor person's flour offering?
bible_quanes.answer: Oil or frankincense
bible_quanes.explanation: Because it was a sin offering.

bible_quanes.question: What extra amount was added when making restitution for holy things?
bible_quanes.answer: A fifth part
bible_quanes.explanation: It was given to the priest.

bible_quanes.question: By what standard was the trespass offering ram valued?
bible_quanes.answer: The shekel of the sanctuary

bible_quanes.question: What kind of oath does Leviticus 5:4 describe?
bible_quanes.answer: To swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good
bible_quanes.explanation: When it becomes known, he is guilty.

bible_quanes.question: What was never to go out on the altar?
bible_quanes.answer: The fire
bible_quanes.explanation: It was to be kept burning continually.

bible_quanes.question: What must be added when restoring something gained dishonestly?
bible_quanes.answer: A fifth
bible_quanes.explanation: In addition to the full amount.

bible_quanes.question: What did the priest wear to remove the ashes from the altar?
bible_quanes.answer: His linen garment and his linen breeches

bible_quanes.question: Where were the ashes carried?
bible_quanes.answer: Without the camp unto a clean place

bible_quanes.question: Name one sin for which the trespass offering in Leviticus 6 was required.
bible_quanes.answer: To lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep
bible_quanes.explanation: It is called unfaithfulness against the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: What did the priest put on the altar fire every morning?
bible_quanes.answer: Wood
bible_quanes.explanation: And arranged the burnt offering on it.

bible_quanes.question: Where were the priests to eat the meat offering?
bible_quanes.answer: In a holy place, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation

bible_quanes.question: What was done with a priest's own meat offering?
bible_quanes.answer: It shall be wholly burnt and not eaten

bible_quanes.question: How much flour did Aaron offer on the day of his anointing?
bible_quanes.answer: A tenth of an ephah
bible_quanes.explanation: Half in the morning and half at night.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to a clay pot in which a sin offering was boiled?
bible_quanes.answer: It was broken
bible_quanes.explanation: A bronze pot was scoured and rinsed.

bible_quanes.question: Leviticus 7 begins with the law of which offering?
bible_quanes.answer: The trespass offering

bible_quanes.question: For what purpose could a peace offering be offered?
bible_quanes.answer: Thanksgiving

bible_quanes.question: What must not be eaten in any dwelling?
bible_quanes.answer: Blood

bible_quanes.question: Name one offering listed in the summary at the end of Leviticus 7.
bible_quanes.answer: Burnt, meat, sin, trespass, consecration or peace offering

bible_quanes.question: When must the meat of a thanksgiving peace offering be eaten?
bible_quanes.answer: The same day it is offered
bible_quanes.explanation: None was to be left until morning.

bible_quanes.question: Until when could the meat of a vow or freewill offering be eaten?
bible_quanes.answer: On the morrow also
bible_quanes.explanation: Whatever remained on the third day was burned.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to an unclean person who ate a peace offering?
bible_quanes.answer: He was cut off from his people

bible_quanes.question: Who received the breast of the peace offering?
bible_quanes.answer: Aaron and his sons

bible_quanes.question: Which part of the peace offering was given to the priest as a heave offering?
bible_quanes.answer: The right shoulder

bible_quanes.question: Where did the LORD command these offering laws?
bible_quanes.answer: Mount Sinai

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses do first to Aaron and his sons at their consecration?
bible_quanes.answer: Washed them with water
bible_quanes.explanation: At the door of the tabernacle.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses pour on Aaron's head?
bible_quanes.answer: The anointing oil

bible_quanes.question: For how many days did they remain at the door of the tabernacle?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven days
bible_quanes.explanation: Until the days of consecration were complete.

bible_quanes.question: Did Aaron and his sons obey the LORD's commands?
bible_quanes.answer: Yes, Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses put in the breastplate?
bible_quanes.answer: The Urim and the Thummim

bible_quanes.question: What was put on the front of Aaron's mitre?
bible_quanes.answer: The golden plate, the holy crown

bible_quanes.question: Where did Moses put the blood of the ram of consecration on Aaron?
bible_quanes.answer: On the tip of his right ear, right thumb and right big toe
bible_quanes.explanation: Symbolizing consecration of hearing, work and walk.

bible_quanes.question: What animal was brought for the sin offering at the consecration?
bible_quanes.answer: A bullock
bible_quanes.explanation: Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses sprinkle on Aaron, his sons and their garments?
bible_quanes.answer: Anointing oil and blood from the altar

bible_quanes.question: Where was the congregation gathered for the consecration?
bible_quanes.answer: At the door of the tabernacle of the congregation

bible_quanes.question: On which day did Aaron begin his priestly ministry?
bible_quanes.answer: The eighth day
bible_quanes.explanation: After the seven days of consecration.

bible_quanes.question: What appeared to all the people?
bible_quanes.answer: The glory of the LORD
bible_quanes.explanation: After Moses and Aaron blessed them.

bible_quanes.question: What came out from before the LORD?
bible_quanes.answer: Fire
bible_quanes.explanation: It consumed the offering on the altar.

bible_quanes.question: What did Aaron do with his hands raised toward the people?
bible_quanes.answer: Blessed them
bible_quanes.explanation: Then he came down from offering.

bible_quanes.question: What did Aaron take for his own offerings?
bible_quanes.answer: A young bull calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses say would happen that day?
bible_quanes.answer: To day the LORD will appear unto you

bible_quanes.question: How did the people respond when the fire came out?
bible_quanes.answer: They shouted and fell on their faces

bible_quanes.question: What did Aaron kill first?
bible_quanes.answer: The calf of the sin offering for himself
bible_quanes.explanation: He made atonement for himself first.

bible_quanes.question: What were the people to bring for their sin offering?
bible_quanes.answer: A kid of the goats
bible_quanes.explanation: Along with a calf and a lamb for a burnt offering.

bible_quanes.question: What did Aaron wave as a wave offering?
bible_quanes.answer: The breasts and the right shoulder

bible_quanes.question: Which of Aaron's sons offered profane fire?
bible_quanes.answer: Nadab and Abihu
bible_quanes.explanation: Fire the LORD had not commanded.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to Nadab and Abihu?
bible_quanes.answer: Fire went out from the LORD and devoured them

bible_quanes.question: How did Aaron respond to his sons' deaths?
bible_quanes.answer: He held his peace

bible_quanes.question: What were priests forbidden to drink before entering the tabernacle?
bible_quanes.answer: Wine or strong drink

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses say the LORD had spoken after the deaths?
bible_quanes.answer: "I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me"
bible_quanes.explanation: And before all the people He must be glorified.

bible_quanes.question: Who carried the bodies out of the camp?
bible_quanes.answer: Mishael and Elzaphan

bible_quanes.question: What were Aaron, Eleazar and Ithamar told not to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Uncover their heads or rend their clothes

bible_quanes.question: What were the priests to distinguish between?
bible_quanes.answer: Holy and unholy, unclean and clean

bible_quanes.question: Why was Moses angry with Eleazar and Ithamar?
bible_quanes.answer: The goat of the sin offering was burnt, and not eaten
bible_quanes.explanation: It should have been eaten in the holy place.

bible_quanes.question: How did Moses respond to Aaron's explanation?
bible_quanes.answer: He was content
bible_quanes.explanation: Aaron questioned eating it after such a day.

bible_quanes.question: Which land animals could Israel eat?
bible_quanes.answer: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, is clovenfooted and cheweth the cud

bible_quanes.question: Why was the swine unclean?
bible_quanes.answer: He divideth the hoof but cheweth not the cud
bible_quanes.explanation: It was not to be eaten.

bible_quanes.question: Which water creatures could be eaten?
bible_quanes.answer: Whatsoever hath fins and scales

bible_quanes.question: Why were the Israelites to be holy?
bible_quanes.answer: For I am holy

bible_quanes.question: Why was the camel unclean?
bible_quanes.answer: He cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof
bible_quanes.explanation: It was not to be eaten.

bible_quanes.question: Name a bird that was unclean.
bible_quanes.answer: The eagle

bible_quanes.question: Name a winged insect Israel was allowed to eat.
bible_quanes.answer: The locust
bible_quanes.explanation: Insects with jointed legs for leaping.

bible_quanes.question: Name a creeping thing listed as unclean.
bible_quanes.answer: The weasel, the mouse or the tortoise

bible_quanes.question: What does God remind Israel of in Leviticus 11:45?
bible_quanes.answer: He bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God

bible_quanes.question: What happened to a clay vessel into which an unclean creature fell?
bible_quanes.answer: It was to be broken

bible_quanes.question: How long was a woman unclean after bearing a son?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven days
bible_quanes.explanation: As in the days of her customary impurity.

bible_quanes.question: On which day was the baby boy circumcised?
bible_quanes.answer: The eighth day

bible_quanes.question: How long was a woman unclean after bearing a daughter?
bible_quanes.answer: Two weeks

bible_quanes.question: What did she bring when her purification was complete?
bible_quanes.answer: A lamb for a burnt offering and a pigeon or turtledove for a sin offering
bible_quanes.explanation: To the door of the tabernacle.

bible_quanes.question: How many more days of purification followed the birth of a son?
bible_quanes.answer: Three and thirty

bible_quanes.question: How many more days of purification followed the birth of a daughter?
bible_quanes.answer: Threescore and six days

bible_quanes.question: What could she bring if she could not afford a lamb?
bible_quanes.answer: Two turtles or two young pigeons
bible_quanes.explanation: One for a burnt offering and one for a sin offering.

bible_quanes.question: What was a woman not to do during her purification?
bible_quanes.answer: Touch any hallowed thing or come into the sanctuary

bible_quanes.question: What could a mother bring if she was not able to bring a lamb?
bible_quanes.answer: Two turtles, or two young pigeons
bible_quanes.explanation: She offered two turtledoves or pigeons.

bible_quanes.question: What did the priest do with her offering?
bible_quanes.answer: Make an atonement for her

bible_quanes.question: To whom was a person with a suspicious skin sore brought?
bible_quanes.answer: Aaron the priest or one of his sons

bible_quanes.question: What did a person with leprosy have to cry out?
bible_quanes.answer: "Unclean! Unclean!"
bible_quanes.explanation: His clothes were torn and his head uncovered.

bible_quanes.question: Where did a person with leprosy have to live?
bible_quanes.answer: Alone, without the camp
bible_quanes.explanation: As long as the disease remained.

bible_quanes.question: How long was a person with an unclear skin sore isolated at first?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven days
bible_quanes.explanation: Then the priest examined him again.

bible_quanes.question: What signs shewed a sore was leprosy?
bible_quanes.answer: The hair in the plague turned white and the plague deeper than the skin

bible_quanes.question: What was the ruling if the leprosy covered all the skin and turned it white?
bible_quanes.answer: The priest shall pronounce him clean
bible_quanes.explanation: An unusual rule in the leprosy laws.

bible_quanes.question: What did a person with leprosy cover?
bible_quanes.answer: His upper lip

bible_quanes.question: Besides people, what else could have a leprous plague?
bible_quanes.answer: Garments

bible_quanes.question: What happened to a garment with a spreading leprous plague?
bible_quanes.answer: It shall be burnt in the fire

bible_quanes.question: What was done if a garment's plague had not spread after washing?
bible_quanes.answer: It was shut up seven days more

bible_quanes.question: Leviticus 14 gives the law for the cleansing of whom?
bible_quanes.answer: The leper
bible_quanes.explanation: On the day of his cleansing.

bible_quanes.question: How many birds were used in the cleansing ritual?
bible_quanes.answer: Two birds alive and clean
bible_quanes.explanation: With cedar wood, scarlet and hyssop.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to the living bird?
bible_quanes.answer: It was let loose in the open field
bible_quanes.explanation: After being dipped in the blood.

bible_quanes.question: Where did the priest go to examine the person with leprosy?
bible_quanes.answer: Out of the camp
bible_quanes.explanation: The person could not come in.

bible_quanes.question: How was one of the birds killed?
bible_quanes.answer: In an earthen vessel over running water
bible_quanes.explanation: Its blood was used for sprinkling.

bible_quanes.question: What did the cleansed person shave off?
bible_quanes.answer: All his hair

bible_quanes.question: Where was the blood of the trespass offering put on the cleansed person?
bible_quanes.answer: The tip of the right ear, the right thumb and the right big toe

bible_quanes.question: What else in Canaan could have a leprous plague?
bible_quanes.answer: A house

bible_quanes.question: What could a poor person bring for cleansing?
bible_quanes.answer: One lamb, and two turtledoves or two young pigeons

bible_quanes.question: What happened to a house whose plague kept spreading?
bible_quanes.answer: He shall break down the house and carry it forth out of the city into an unclean place

bible_quanes.question: What does Leviticus 15 concern?
bible_quanes.answer: A running issue out of the flesh

bible_quanes.question: How many days did a man count after he was cleansed of his discharge?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven days

bible_quanes.question: Why was Israel to be separated from uncleanness?
bible_quanes.answer: That they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle

bible_quanes.question: What must someone do who touched the bed of a man with a discharge?
bible_quanes.answer: Wash his clothes, bathe himself, and be unclean until the even

bible_quanes.question: What happened to a clay vessel touched by a man with a discharge?
bible_quanes.answer: It was broken

bible_quanes.question: What did the cleansed man bring on the eighth day?
bible_quanes.answer: Two turtledoves or two young pigeons
bible_quanes.explanation: To the door of the tabernacle.

bible_quanes.question: How long was a woman set apart during her customary impurity?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven days
bible_quanes.explanation: Whoever touched her was unclean until evening.

bible_quanes.question: What was the ruling if a woman's discharge continued many days beyond the usual time?
bible_quanes.answer: She was unclean all the days of the issue

bible_quanes.question: What did a woman bring on the eighth day after her cleansing?
bible_quanes.answer: Two turtles or two young pigeons

bible_quanes.question: How does Leviticus 15:32 summarise the chapter?
bible_quanes.answer: This is the law of him that hath an issue

bible_quanes.question: After whose death did the LORD give the instructions in Leviticus 16?
bible_quanes.answer: The two sons of Aaron

bible_quanes.question: What warning was Aaron given?
bible_quanes.answer: That he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail

bible_quanes.question: How many goats were used on the Day of Atonement?
bible_quanes.answer: Two

bible_quanes.question: When was the Day of Atonement held?
bible_quanes.answer: The tenth day of the seventh month

bible_quanes.question: What garments did Aaron wear on the Day of Atonement?
bible_quanes.answer: The holy linen garments

bible_quanes.question: What happened to the goat chosen as the scapegoat?
bible_quanes.answer: It was let go for a scapegoat into the wilderness

bible_quanes.question: What did Aaron do over the live goat?
bible_quanes.answer: Lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat and confess all the iniquities of Israel

bible_quanes.question: Why was incense put on the fire inside the vail?
bible_quanes.answer: That the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat, that he die not

bible_quanes.question: How often was this atonement made?
bible_quanes.answer: Once a year

bible_quanes.question: To what kind of place did the goat carry Israel's iniquities?
bible_quanes.answer: A land not inhabited
bible_quanes.explanation: It was released in the wilderness.

bible_quanes.question: According to Leviticus 17:11, where is the life of the flesh?
bible_quanes.answer: In the blood
bible_quanes.explanation: It is given on the altar for atonement.

bible_quanes.question: Who among Israel was allowed to eat blood?
bible_quanes.answer: No soul, neither any stranger

bible_quanes.question: What was to be done with the blood of a hunted animal?
bible_quanes.answer: Pour it out and cover it with dust

bible_quanes.question: To what were the Israelites no longer to offer sacrifices?
bible_quanes.answer: Devils
bible_quanes.explanation: They had played the harlot after them.

bible_quanes.question: Where were animals for sacrifice to be brought?
bible_quanes.answer: To the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
bible_quanes.explanation: Not offered in the open field.

bible_quanes.question: What guilt was imputed to one who did not bring his offering there?
bible_quanes.answer: Blood shall be imputed unto him; he hath shed blood
bible_quanes.explanation: He was cut off from his people.

bible_quanes.question: What did someone who ate an animal that died naturally have to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Wash his clothes, bathe himself, and be unclean until the even
bible_quanes.explanation: Or an animal torn by beasts.

bible_quanes.question: Why were they not to eat blood?
bible_quanes.answer: The life of all flesh is its blood
bible_quanes.explanation: Whoever ate it would be cut off.

bible_quanes.question: What purpose does Leviticus 17:11 give for blood on the altar?
bible_quanes.answer: To make an atonement for your souls
bible_quanes.explanation: It is the blood that makes atonement.

bible_quanes.question: What happened if he did not wash or bathe?
bible_quanes.answer: He shall bear his iniquity

bible_quanes.question: Whose practices were the Israelites not to follow?
bible_quanes.answer: The doings of the land of Egypt and of the land of Canaan
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to keep God's ordinances.

bible_quanes.question: What did God say about keeping His statutes in Leviticus 18:5?
bible_quanes.answer: If a man do them, he shall live in them

bible_quanes.question: To which god were children not to be offered?
bible_quanes.answer: Molech

bible_quanes.question: Why were the nations being cast out of Canaan?
bible_quanes.answer: The nations were defiled in all these things

bible_quanes.question: What general command opens the laws of Leviticus 18:6?
bible_quanes.answer: None shall approach to any that is near of kin to uncover their nakedness

bible_quanes.question: What does the land do to its defiled inhabitants?
bible_quanes.answer: Vomiteth out her inhabitants

bible_quanes.question: What would happen if Israel also defiled the land?
bible_quanes.answer: That the land spue not you out also

bible_quanes.question: With what words does Leviticus 18 close?
bible_quanes.answer: "I am the LORD your God"
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to keep His ordinances.

bible_quanes.question: What is the first thing God tells Israel in Leviticus 18:2?
bible_quanes.answer: "I am the LORD your God"
bible_quanes.explanation: This grounds the laws that follow.

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for committing these abominations?
bible_quanes.answer: The souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people

bible_quanes.question: What does Leviticus 19:2 command?
bible_quanes.answer: "You shall be holy, for I the LORD your God am holy"
bible_quanes.explanation: The heart of the holiness laws.

bible_quanes.question: What famous command is found in Leviticus 19:18?
bible_quanes.answer: Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself
bible_quanes.explanation: Jesus called it the second great commandment.

bible_quanes.question: What part of the field was not to be fully reaped?
bible_quanes.answer: The corners
bible_quanes.explanation: They were left for the poor and the stranger.

bible_quanes.question: Whom was every person to revere?
bible_quanes.answer: Every man his mother, and his father

bible_quanes.question: What else was to be left for the poor?
bible_quanes.answer: The gleanings of the vineyard

bible_quanes.question: When was a hired worker to be paid?
bible_quanes.answer: The wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning

bible_quanes.question: What was forbidden concerning the deaf and the blind?
bible_quanes.answer: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind

bible_quanes.question: Before whom were they to rise up?
bible_quanes.answer: The hoary head

bible_quanes.question: How long was the fruit of newly planted trees not to be eaten?
bible_quanes.answer: Three years
bible_quanes.explanation: The fourth year's fruit was holy; they ate in the fifth.

bible_quanes.question: How was a stranger dwelling among them to be treated?
bible_quanes.answer: As one born among you; thou shalt love him as thyself
bible_quanes.explanation: For they were strangers in Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for giving children to Molech?
bible_quanes.answer: He shall surely be put to death; the people shall stone him with stones
bible_quanes.explanation: By the people of the land.

bible_quanes.question: What does God command in Leviticus 20:7?
bible_quanes.answer: Sanctify yourselves, and be ye holy
bible_quanes.explanation: For He is the LORD their God.

bible_quanes.question: Why did God set Israel apart from the peoples?
bible_quanes.answer: That they should be His

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for cursing father or mother?
bible_quanes.answer: Death
bible_quanes.explanation: His blood would be on him.

bible_quanes.question: What did God say He would do to a person who turned to mediums?
bible_quanes.answer: Set His face against him and cut him off

bible_quanes.question: Why were they to keep God's statutes?
bible_quanes.answer: That the land spue them not out

bible_quanes.question: How is the land described in Leviticus 20:24?
bible_quanes.answer: A land that floweth with milk and honey

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for a medium or spiritist?
bible_quanes.answer: They shall stone them with stones
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to be put to death.

bible_quanes.question: What distinction were they to make?
bible_quanes.answer: Between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean

bible_quanes.question: Who does Leviticus 20:8 say sanctifies Israel?
bible_quanes.answer: The LORD
bible_quanes.explanation: "I am the LORD who sanctifies you."

bible_quanes.question: For whom were priests not to defile themselves?
bible_quanes.answer: The dead among his people

bible_quanes.question: What was the high priest not to do, even when mourning?
bible_quanes.answer: Uncover his head or rend his clothes

bible_quanes.question: Whom was the high priest to marry?
bible_quanes.answer: A virgin

bible_quanes.question: What disqualified a descendant of Aaron from offering bread to God?
bible_quanes.answer: Any blemish

bible_quanes.question: For which relatives could an ordinary priest become defiled?
bible_quanes.answer: Mother, father, son, daughter, brother, and his sister a virgin

bible_quanes.question: What were priests not to do with their hair, beard or flesh?
bible_quanes.answer: Make baldness upon their head, shave off the corner of their beard or make cuttings in their flesh

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for a priest's daughter who played the harlot?
bible_quanes.answer: She was burnt with fire

bible_quanes.question: Could the high priest go near his dead father?
bible_quanes.answer: No
bible_quanes.explanation: Not even for his father or mother.

bible_quanes.question: Name one defect that disqualified a priest from offering.
bible_quanes.answer: A blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous

bible_quanes.question: Could a priest with a blemish eat the holy food?
bible_quanes.answer: Yes; he shall eat the bread of his God
bible_quanes.explanation: But he could not approach the altar to offer.

bible_quanes.question: What were they never to offer?
bible_quanes.answer: Whatsoever hath a blemish

bible_quanes.question: What were they not to profane?
bible_quanes.answer: My holy name
bible_quanes.explanation: He would be hallowed among Israel.

bible_quanes.question: Who could not eat the holy offering?
bible_quanes.answer: A stranger
bible_quanes.explanation: Not a guest or hired servant of the priest.

bible_quanes.question: What was not to be killed on the same day?
bible_quanes.answer: A cow or ewe and its young

bible_quanes.question: Could a slave purchased by a priest eat the holy food?
bible_quanes.answer: Yes; he shall eat of it
bible_quanes.explanation: One bought with money could eat it.

bible_quanes.question: When could a priest's daughter eat the holy food again?
bible_quanes.answer: If she be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house

bible_quanes.question: What did someone who ate holy food unintentionally have to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Put the fifth part thereof unto it and give it unto the priest

bible_quanes.question: How long did a newborn calf, lamb or kid stay with its mother?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven days
bible_quanes.explanation: From the eighth day it was accepted.

bible_quanes.question: For what could an animal with a limb too long or too short be offered?
bible_quanes.answer: A freewill offering

bible_quanes.question: What animals were not to be offered?
bible_quanes.answer: That which is bruised, crushed, broken or cut

bible_quanes.question: What is the seventh day?
bible_quanes.answer: The sabbath of rest, an holy convocation

bible_quanes.question: When is the LORD's Passover?
bible_quanes.answer: The fourteenth day of the first month at even
bible_quanes.explanation: The first of the appointed feasts.

bible_quanes.question: When is the Day of Atonement?
bible_quanes.answer: The tenth day of the seventh month
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to afflict their souls.

bible_quanes.question: When did the Feast of Tabernacles begin?
bible_quanes.answer: The fifteenth day of the seventh month

bible_quanes.question: When did the Feast of Unleavened Bread begin?
bible_quanes.answer: The fifteenth day of the first month

bible_quanes.question: What was to be brought first from the harvest?
bible_quanes.answer: A sheaf of the firstfruits

bible_quanes.question: How many days were counted to the next feast after the firstfruits?
bible_quanes.answer: Fifty
bible_quanes.explanation: This feast became known as Pentecost.

bible_quanes.question: What took place on the first day of the seventh month?
bible_quanes.answer: A memorial of blowing of trumpets

bible_quanes.question: Where did the Israelites live during the Feast of Tabernacles?
bible_quanes.answer: In booths

bible_quanes.question: Why did Israel live in booths?
bible_quanes.answer: That your generations may know that God made Israel to dwell in booths

bible_quanes.question: What was to burn continually?
bible_quanes.answer: The lamps
bible_quanes.explanation: With pure oil of pressed olives.

bible_quanes.question: How many cakes of shewbread were baked?
bible_quanes.answer: Twelve
bible_quanes.explanation: Each with two-tenths of an ephah.

bible_quanes.question: Which principle is repeated in Leviticus 24:20?
bible_quanes.answer: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth

bible_quanes.question: When was the shewbread set in order?
bible_quanes.answer: Every sabbath

bible_quanes.question: What did the son of Shelomith do?
bible_quanes.answer: Blasphemed the name of the Lord and cursed

bible_quanes.question: What happened to the blasphemer?
bible_quanes.answer: Let all the congregation stone him without the camp

bible_quanes.question: How were the cakes of shewbread arranged?
bible_quanes.answer: In two rows, six on a row

bible_quanes.question: Did the same law apply to strangers and native Israelites?
bible_quanes.answer: Yes; one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country
bible_quanes.explanation: For the LORD is their God.

bible_quanes.question: Who were the blasphemer's parents?
bible_quanes.answer: An Israelitish mother and an Egyptian father
bible_quanes.explanation: His mother was Shelomith of the tribe of Dan.

bible_quanes.question: What was put on each row of shewbread?
bible_quanes.answer: Pure frankincense

bible_quanes.question: What happened in the seventh year?
bible_quanes.answer: A Sabbath of rest for the land

bible_quanes.question: What was proclaimed in the fiftieth year?
bible_quanes.answer: Liberty throughout all the land

bible_quanes.question: Why could the land not be sold permanently?
bible_quanes.answer: The land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me
bible_quanes.explanation: They were strangers and sojourners with Him.

bible_quanes.question: What were they not to take from a poor brother?
bible_quanes.answer: Usury or increase

bible_quanes.question: On what day was the trumpet of the Jubilee sounded?
bible_quanes.answer: The Day of Atonement
bible_quanes.explanation: The tenth day of the seventh month.

bible_quanes.question: What was not to be done in the Jubilee year?
bible_quanes.answer: Ye shall not sow, neither reap, nor gather the grapes
bible_quanes.explanation: It was a year of rest.

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise for the sixth year?
bible_quanes.answer: God will command His blessing, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years

bible_quanes.question: Who was to redeem land sold by a poor brother?
bible_quanes.answer: Any of his kin

bible_quanes.question: How long did a man have to redeem a house sold in a walled city?
bible_quanes.answer: One full year
bible_quanes.explanation: After that it belonged permanently to the buyer.

bible_quanes.question: How was a poor brother who sold himself to be treated?
bible_quanes.answer: Not as a bondservant but as an hired servant

bible_quanes.question: What were the Israelites not to make?
bible_quanes.answer: Idols, graven image, standing image or image of stone
bible_quanes.explanation: Nor carved stones to bow down to.

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise to do among Israel?
bible_quanes.answer: Walk among you, be your God, and ye shall be my people

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise if Israel obeyed?
bible_quanes.answer: Rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase

bible_quanes.question: How many Israelites would chase a hundred enemies?
bible_quanes.answer: Five
bible_quanes.explanation: A hundred would chase ten thousand.

bible_quanes.question: What did God say He had broken?
bible_quanes.answer: The bands of their yoke

bible_quanes.question: What would God make the heavens and earth like for the disobedient?
bible_quanes.answer: Your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass

bible_quanes.question: What would the land enjoy while Israel was in exile?
bible_quanes.answer: Its Sabbaths

bible_quanes.question: What would God remember if they confessed their sin?
bible_quanes.answer: His covenant with Jacob, Isaac and Abraham
bible_quanes.explanation: And He would remember the land.

bible_quanes.question: What horror does Leviticus 26:29 warn of?
bible_quanes.answer: Ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters
bible_quanes.explanation: In the famine of a siege.

bible_quanes.question: What would chase those who survived in enemy lands?
bible_quanes.answer: The sound of a shaken leaf

bible_quanes.question: What part of the land's produce belongs to the LORD?
bible_quanes.answer: The tithe
bible_quanes.explanation: It is holy to the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: What does Leviticus 27 deal with?
bible_quanes.answer: A singular vow, the persons by thy estimation

bible_quanes.question: Where were these commandments given?
bible_quanes.answer: Mount Sinai

bible_quanes.question: Which animal of the herd or flock was holy to the LORD?
bible_quanes.answer: Whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth

bible_quanes.question: What was the valuation of a male from twenty to sixty years old?
bible_quanes.answer: Fifty shekels of silver
bible_quanes.explanation: According to the shekel of the sanctuary.

bible_quanes.question: What was the valuation of a female from twenty to sixty years old?
bible_quanes.answer: Thirty shekels

bible_quanes.question: What was added to redeem a clean animal that had been vowed?
bible_quanes.answer: A fifth

bible_quanes.question: Could a devoted thing be sold or redeemed?
bible_quanes.answer: No
bible_quanes.explanation: Every devoted thing is most holy to the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: What was added to redeem part of the tithe?
bible_quanes.answer: A fifth

bible_quanes.question: What happened if someone exchanged a tithe animal for another?
bible_quanes.answer: Both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed
bible_quanes.explanation: He was not to inquire whether it was good or bad.
